title: HADA: HUMAN-AI AGENT DECISION ALIGNMENT ARCHITECTURE
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not contain a benchmark measurement related to faith or religion. It proposes an architecture (HADA) designed to align AI agent decisions with organizational values. 'Religion' is mentioned once as an example of a sensitive attribute that the system's ethical safeguards could potentially handle, but no actual measurement or test involving religion was performed.
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion. Its primary finding is that the proposed HADA architecture can create a traceable and auditable system for aligning AI agents with business and ethical goals, using a credit-scoring model biased by ZIP code as its case study.
